transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

I just... don't feel like myself lately. I barely talk to anyone anymore. I just get quiet, you know? Flat. And work... I clean buildings, but just getting started on my route feels like trying to push a loaded cart uphill. It's just... hard.
Do you still enjoy things you used to like doing?

Not really, no. I used to... I liked fishing on Saturdays. Or just sitting with a crossword and a cup of coffee. Even at work, I used to like showing the new guys how to strip a floor right. Now... I don't know. I just let it all sit. It doesn't... none of it gives me anything back anymore. So I just don't do it.
Do you feel any pleasure when you do things, even small things, like eating or taking a warm shower?
No. Not really. I just... I eat because I'm supposed to. Showers are just... another thing I have to do. It's all just the same.
Do you think things will ever get better for you?
I don't know. I guess... I haven't really thought about it. It just is what it is right now.
Have you ever thought about hurting yourself?

...No. Not like that. I don't have some... big plan or anything. 

It's just... I don't know. A lot of mornings, I wake up and just think... it might be easier if I didn't wake up at all. I guess... well, it scares me enough to actually say it out loud to you right now. But no, I haven't tried to do anything.
How long have you been feeling this way?

I don't know... a while, I guess. Maybe... maybe almost a year and a half? It just kind of started creeping in... around the time I had to move. Left my old apartment, my old neighborhood... it's been about a year and five months since then. Just been... building up since that happened.
Do you find yourself moving more slowly than you used to or having trouble sitting still?
I don't think so. I mean... I just do my job, clean the buildings, come home. I haven't really noticed moving any different. Just... normal, I guess.
Have you noticed any changes in your weight recently?

I guess... yeah, a little. My work pants are definitely hanging a bit looser lately. I just... I don't really eat much anymore. Most days, food just tastes like cardboard. So I end up skipping meals... maybe just have a few crackers when I get home from my shift. That's about it.
Do you often feel guilty about things?

I don't know... I guess so. I just... I think about how I lost my old place. How I just couldn't keep things together. It feels like... like I failed everybody. Even things that aren't mine to fix, I just... if the church pantry doesn't have enough food, or if I miss a spot in one of the hallways at work... I don't know. It just feels like it's my fault somehow.
Do you often feel worthless?

I guess... yeah. It's... kind of like what I just was saying. I just feel like I'm not good for much. Because I couldn't keep my life together... losing my place and all. I just... I feel like a failure to everybody. Even with the church pantry or... or missing spots at work. I don't know. Just useless, I guess.
Have you ever heard voices or seen things that other people couldn't hear or see?

...I don't know. Sometimes, maybe. When I'm mopping after hours... I'll hear a man's voice. He'll say my name, or... tell me I missed a spot. It sounds real clear. Like he's just standing right over by the stairwell. But then I look, and... there's nobody there. Just me.
Do you feel like you're at the worst point you've ever been in your life right now?

...I don't know about that. I mean... things aren't good right now, obviously. But... I guess I've had other bad times before. It's hard to say if it's the absolute worst. I just... I don't really know.
Do you feel like you're unable to experience any kind of positive emotion at all, even briefly?

I don't know about... not feeling anything at all. But... I don't really care about much anymore. I used to go fishing on Saturdays. Or... just sit with a coffee and a crossword. Even at work, I liked showing the new guys how to strip a floor right. Now... I don't know. I just let the poles and the puzzles sit there. Doing them doesn't... it doesn't make me feel any better. So I just don't do them.
Do you feel like you're resting or sleeping more than you used to?
...Not really. I mean, I'm tired a lot. But... I don't think I'm sleeping more. Just... laying there, mostly. I don't really keep track.
Have you had any periods in the last two weeks where you felt slightly better for a few days?
...No. Not really. It's just... been about the same, I guess. I haven't noticed any difference.
Have you had any days in the last two weeks where you felt almost back to your normal self?
...No. I haven't.
Have you had any periods in the last two weeks where you felt so bad that you couldn't get out of bed?
...No. I get up. I mean... I still have to go in to work, so... I don't stay in bed all day. Just... drag myself out, I guess.
Have you had any other experiences like hearing voices when you're alone, besides the man's voice you mentioned earlier?

...No. Just that one. Just... when I'm mopping after hours. I'll hear him say my name, or... tell me I missed a spot. It's clear. Like he's standing right by the stairwell. But... there's nobody there when I look. So, just him.
Do you feel like you're moving slower or faster than usual when you're doing things?

...Slower, I guess. Sometimes I just... get stuck. Like at work, I'll be cleaning and I just keep wiping the same patch of glass. Over and over. Or I'll go to the supply closet and just... stand in there. Holding the broom. It just feels like I have to wait for... the right sign, I guess. Before I can move on to the next thing. So... yeah. Slower.
Have you experienced any other hallucinations besides the man's voice you mentioned earlier?
...I think I just answered that. It's just the one voice. Like I said, when I'm mopping. He just... says my name or tells me I missed a spot. That's it. Nobody else.
